## Approved scope

- Which human-approved Ready roadmap milestone authorizes this work? Link it and its accepted design basis.
- Which requirements, decisions, designs, anchors, and criteria are affected? State none where applicable.
- What Book material changed?

## Evidence

- What evidence supports each affected criterion?
- Which revision was tested, and what is its integration state?
- What was not tested? What limitations or open decisions remain?
- Were the documented Rust and Book checks, bootstrap consistency check, and whitespace check run? Give commands and results; explain omissions.

## Review and delivery

- Has a deliberate review pass separate from implementation been completed? Who or what performed it? Record significant findings and their resolution.
- What required CI and human review remain before owner-authorized merge?
- Does this introduce TypeScript-specific migration material that must be removed at the end of the Porting Phase? Identify it and any notices/provenance that must remain.
- Is the owning roadmap ready to be synchronized after merge with integrated revision and completion evidence?

Milestone completion does not approve the separate end-of-Porting-Phase transition.
